visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt, is seated at a dark desk in a studio setting. He holds a black pen in his right hand and gestures as he speaks. Behind him is a large window view of the Taipei 101 skyscraper at night, illuminated with cyan and yellow lights against a dark urban skyline. A large rectangular overlay appears in the center showing a young man with curly brown hair in a brown corduroy jacket sitting in an indoor studio. (2) The central overlay transitions to a technical flowchart diagram titled 'NEOWISE-P1VD DATABASE' with various technical blocks like 'VARnet Classifier' and 'APPARITION CLUSTERING'. The man in the black shirt remains visible behind the graphic, continuing to gesture. Yellow and white captions are centered at the bottom of the frame. (3) The graphic disappears, focusing back on the man at the desk. He continues talking while holding his pen. A blue and white circular logo for 'PanSci News' is fixed in the top-left corner. The background remains the night city skyline. (4) An overlay of a white academic paper screenshot appears, titled 'A Submillisecond Fourier and Wavelet-based Model...'. The text is dense and scientific. The host's hands are visible at the sides of the frame as he gestures toward the document. (5) The host is shown in a medium shot again, speaking emphatically. He occasionally looks down at papers on his desk. The scene ends with him continuing his presentation against the static night background.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: 泛科學 NEWS. [Slogan]: 18 歲開外掛！發現 150 萬顆新天體！. [Subtitle]: 這位美國高中生. (2) [Subtitle]: 最近做了一件. (3) [Subtitle]: 讓天文學家跌破眼鏡的事. (4) [Subtitle]: 他開發了一種新的 AI 演算法. (5) [Subtitle]: 發現了 150 萬個未知的主宙天體. (6) [Subtitle]: Matteo Paz 在. (7) [Subtitle]: 加州理工學院天文學家. (8) [Subtitle]: Davy Kirkpatrick 的指導下. (9) [Subtitle]: 運用機器學習分析. (10) [Subtitle]: NASA NEOWISE 太空望遠鏡的紅外數據. (11) [Subtitle]: 呃不多啦. (12) [Subtitle]: 就 2000 億筆. (13) [Subtitle]: 記錄了過去 10 年. (14) [Subtitle]: 所有可觀測天空的紅外訊號. (15) [Subtitle]: 欸呀天文學當然要天文數字. (16) [Subtitle]: 習慣就好. (17) [Subtitle]: 那總之入眼根本看不完. (18) [Subtitle]: 但他的 AI 「VARnet」. (19) [Subtitle]: 融合了小波分析. (20) [Subtitle]: 傅立葉轉換與深度學習. (21) [Subtitle]: 搭配此刻強大的 GPU. (22) [Subtitle]: 不止迅速看完 2000 億筆的資料. (23) [Subtitle]: 還能偵測微小的亮度變化. (24) [Subtitle]: 把過去被漏掉的天體一一標記出來. (25) [Subtitle]: 這些新發現包含變星、新星. (26) [Subtitle]: 甚至遠方的類星體. (27) [Subtitle]: 他還作為唯一作者. (28) [Subtitle]: 將最終結果發表在. (29) [Subtitle]: 「天文學期刊」上. (30) [Subtitle]: 更靠這個發現. (31) [Subtitle]: 獲得美國高中生最大科學競賽. (32) [Subtitle]: 「再生元科學獎」的首獎. (33) [Subtitle]: 他甚至認為. (34) [Subtitle]: 他開發的這套 AI 模型. (35) [Subtitle]: 不止在天文界有用. (36) [Subtitle]: 只要是有時間格式的資料都行. (37) [Subtitle]: 欸研究大氣效應、股票走勢. (38) [Subtitle]: 都可能派上用場. (39) [Subtitle]: 嗯不過這 AI 算得到川普想幹嘛嗎. (40) [Subtitle]: 年輕的科學家加油吧.
